text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp starts today. Haru Urara is…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Trainer! I've put away my luggage and changed clothes!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So come on, Let's hurry up and start my training already!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I mean, yeah! I gotta train hard!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I gotta run hard and train hard! Harder, better, faster, stronger!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: If I do that, then I'm sure to win! So let's get down to business!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara is the epitome of energy right now, which means I also need to gear up and give her some effective training!
